saints.name: Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia
saints.sourceTitle: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia
saints.dates: Early Church period; exact chronology not established here

summary.text: Cosmas and Damian are remembered as unmercenary physicians who cared for others without payment. The OCA page's title places them in Mesopotamia, while its text gives Asia Minor and notes Mesopotamia as another account. The brothers commemorated here on November 1 must be distinguished from pairs of the same names associated with Rome on July 1 and Arabia on October 17.
summary.reason: A concise navigation synopsis is necessary because full reproduction rights for this modern published life have not been established. Read its complete account at the identified source; the synopsis is not a quotation.

It transmits biographical material, received traditions, and—in some accounts—miracle narratives. Those claims remain attributed to this source; this app has not independently established a critical historical chronology or verified each miraculous episode. The page title says Mesopotamia, while its text says Asia Minor and notes Mesopotamia as an alternative. This regional difference is visible rather than silently resolved.
